summary: Tested Tasaciones Equipamiento % (5/7.5/10) and the zone map picker in the manual tasador, plus the public /tasar page. Backend: 11/12 pytest pass. Manual tasador UI: everything requested works. Map modal: 22 zones, map and list stay in sync both ways, Listo and X both close it. Equipamiento select has 4 options and is hidden for Lote. On Casa/av2/100m2/300m2/estandar/bueno/hasta10 the closing value was 124000-135000 with no equipamiento, 130500-141500 at +5%, 133500-145000 at +7.5% and 136500-148500 at +10% (+10.0%). JPG download, save with owner/address and the manual list all work. Public /tasar shows tasp-equipamiento with the 4 options and no JS errors. One real gap: the public estimator ignores equipamiento in zones that are not calibrated, which is 21 of 22 zones today.

minor.issue: Equipamiento (and all amenities/multipliers) has no effect when the zone is uncalibrated (precio_lote_{zona}=0). Only av2=205 is calibrated, so 21 of 22 zones use the method='mercadolibre' branch in tasacion_online.estimar: base = market medianPm2 * area, and the tasar() result is thrown away. Repro: casa/centro/100/300 gives estMax=146500 both with and without equipamiento='10'. A public user picks 'Equipada +10%' and the estimate does not change. Fix: in the ML branch, apply (1+EQUIPAMIENTO_PCT) to base when tipo != lote (and possibly cercaniaMar).

equipamiento is not saved in the manual record. Also, the uuid5 dedupe key leaves out equipamiento, so re-running the same property with a different % overwrites the earlier record. This is probably acceptable; just make sure it is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: The sidebar and topbar sit above the modal backdrop: document.elementFromPoint(30,540) returns .vera-sidebar, and both stay undimmed and clickable. Clicking the sidebar area does not close the modal. Raise the .vera-modal z-index above the sidebar/topbar, or render the modal in a portal.

At 1920x1080 the panel (scrollHeight 1062 vs clientHeight 970) needs scrolling to reach the 'Listo' button, because the map image plus the avenue pills fill the panel. Consider a smaller map max-height or a sticky footer for Listo.

issues: The 'Equipamiento' label sits right under the last checkbox row (Quincho/Deck/Cochera) with no top margin; add a gap like the manual form's tas__row2.

action_items: Apply equipamiento in tasacion_online.estimar when the method is 'mercadolibre' (uncalibrated zones), otherwise the new public select does nothing in 21 of 22 zones
(Low) Give the zone map modal a z-index above the sidebar/topbar, and keep 'Listo' visible without scrolling at 1080p
(Low) Add spacing above the Equipamiento select in the public /tasar form
critical_code_review_comments: tasacion.tasar: equipamiento is applied correctly after cercaniaMar and skipped for lote; unknown values fall back to 0% safely.
When the user switches tipo to lote, f.equipamiento keeps its previous value and is still sent; the backend ignores it, so this is harmless.
TasacionesScreen.tsx guardarLead/generarJpg do not handle fetch errors (no try/catch); this was already the case before.

The public form was not submitted, so no lead was created. 'Guardar lead' was not clicked, so no person was created.
